subject: CosyVoice local TTS provider materialization under the provider-neutral FA3 Voice Fabric
mandatory_policy: CosyVoice SHALL remain a replaceable execution provider, never an FA3 authority.
Voice cloning SHALL require explicit typed consent and reference-audio hash binding.
CUDA execution SHALL require Host Resource Broker admission/lease.
Runtime/model provenance SHALL be immutable and evidence-backed.
Silent runtime model download SHALL be forbidden; bootstrap download is explicit.
Provider runtime SHALL use a dedicated Python 3.10 venv and SHALL NOT require Conda.
Current-host admission SHALL require SoX availability.
Hungarian SHALL remain experimental until dedicated hu-HU voice quality evidence passes.
